title: From Math QA to Real Conversations: Does Sycophancy Transfer Across Domains?

original_idea.body: Run same models across factual/math/debate sycophancy probes; test trait-stability.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (sycophancy as stable trait could become a model-card metric) but catastrophic-risk link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: run same models across 3 domain probes, correlate; assembling 3 probes adds mild effort.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused; depends on assembling three domain probes, contained.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public benchmarks, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across public probes; single GPU.
